description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'WebViewScreen' that displays a web page or local asset inside a WebView. It handles asset path sanitization, platform-specific asset loading, and displays loading/error UI.

classes.name: WebViewScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget providing a WebView to display local HTML assets based on a given path.

methods.name: WebViewScreen(…) constructor
methods.description: Initializes the WebViewScreen with a specified asset path.

methods.name: _WebViewScreenState.initState
methods.description: Initializes the WebViewController, sanitizes the path, and starts loading content.

methods.name: _sanitizeAssetPath
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes the input path for asset loading.

methods.name: _loadInitialContent
methods.description: Loads the HTML content into the WebView, platform-specific for iOS/macOS versus Android.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget's UI, including the WebView, loading indicator, and error message display.
